_comment: Local password accounts. Copy to users.json and manage it with the CLI
go-notes user add josh          — add, or change a password
go-notes user remove josh       — remove (their notes stay on disk)
podman exec -it go-notes go-notes user add josh
Hashes are argon2id at OWASP's recommended parameters. A plaintext password
here is rejected at startup with an explanation rather than silently failing.
